<div class="card-body">
'''Zutton''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ザットン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">配備されているロケーションで、敵が戦闘運命数を引く直前に、1フォースを消費して、敵の戦闘運命数の合計から1を引くことができる（戦闘運命数の合計は0を下回ることはない）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Zutton-PSA-164793248.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">“そっ歯”のあだ名を持つスニヴィアン。苦悩する芸術家。他のスニヴィアンと同様、自らの作り出した物語の世界を生き抜くはめとなる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Zutton.

'''Card text:'''
Where he is deployed, just before opponent draws battle destiny, you may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from opponent's total battle destiny (cannot fall below 0).

'''Lore:'''
A Snivvian nicknamed “Snaggletooth.” A tortured artist. Like other Snivvians, he is driven to live out the stories he creates.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore uses そっ歯 for Snaggletooth.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Zutton]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
